==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{FormerFA|review page name}}</nowiki></code>

The template handles review pages automatically up to the fourth review. The fifth and any subsequent reviews necessitate passing the review page as a parameter in the template. /Legends review pages are also handled by the template.
